case.value: As the bulls (Needham's maintained Buy with a $90 target, BofA's fresh initiation) frame it, Amkor is the U.S.-based advanced-packaging OSAT play for the AI/HPC build-out, anchored by a $7 billion Arizona campus where Apple will be the first and largest customer and Nvidia is also a named customer.

depends_on.value: Whether Arizona advanced-packaging capacity ramps into real AI/HPC and Apple volume fast enough to offset the near-term communications-segment decline from the South Korea-to-Vietnam SiP migration and soft memory demand flagged in the Q3 guide.

bear_case.value: Free cash flow has swung to -$172M TTM as Arizona capex ramps, TTM P/E is well above its 5-year median, insiders have been sellers only (five open-market sales in the last 90 days, no buys), and the stock is down over 50% from its 52-week high with guidance still soft in the core communications/memory-linked business.

peers.note: ASE Technology Holding (NYSE: ASX) is #1 OSAT globally (44.6% 2024 share) vs Amkor's #2 (15.2%); JCET Group (#3, 12%) trades in Shanghai/Shenzhen, not fetchable via the US-source registry

why_it_fell.value: Stock is down 50.6% from its 52-week high mainly on the July 27 Q2 print: EPS and revenue beat, but Q3 guidance flagged a communications-segment revenue decline tied to migrating system-in-package manufacturing from South Korea to Vietnam plus soft memory-related demand, which triggered a 24.7% one-day drop; a premium valuation (TTM P/E well above its 5-year median) and insider-sell-only activity have kept pressure on the stock since.

judgment.prospect_why: The case is that advanced packaging for AI and HPC plus the $7B Arizona campus with Apple and Nvidia re-rates the business; the driver is in announced capex and backlog rather than in the last two prints, and the comms segment guide was cut, so visibility is guided at best.
judgment.competition_why: Gross margin is range-bound at 14-17% with no widening, ASX trades at 26.6x forward against Amkor's cheaper multiple, and the highest-value packaging work is being taken in-house by the foundry, which is a named substitute already taking the best business.
judgment.macro_fit_why: A capital-intensive, low-margin cyclical running TTM free cash flow of -$172.4M while committing to a $7B campus is the wrong shape for a regime pricing 1.5 hikes by December with the 10-year at 4.77%.
judgment.narrative_why: It sits inside the AI capex theme, which the macro brief rates stable rather than accelerating with a capex-fatigue counter-narrative building, and its own print was met with a 24.7% fall, so the theme is not currently carrying it.
